scope: Frozen before START. E paths relative to new evidence; native paths are exact .autopilot copies. No cognitive claims. Functional criteria unchanged.

gates.name: launcher
gates.pass_condition: Native batch dispatched once to owned Runner
gates.verification: checks.real_launcher_started and actual RUN_STARTED

gates.name: prepare
gates.pass_condition: Native Prepare PASS for fresh project
gates.verification: prepare.status == PASS

gates.name: preflight
gates.pass_condition: Native admission PASS before approval/START
gates.verification: preflight.status == PASS

gates.name: approval
gates.pass_condition: One approval receipt matches frozen inputs
gates.verification: single_approval and digest and every pinned hash unchanged

gates.name: runner
gates.pass_condition: Native live run starts and terminates COMPLETED
gates.verification: RUN_STARTED backend live and runner_completed

gates.name: llama
gates.pass_condition: Owned model health ready; frozen configuration
gates.verification: MODEL_HEALTH_READY and pinned system config

gates.name: supervisor
gates.pass_condition: Native independent role succeeds
gates.verification: roles.supervisor.status SUCCESS

gates.name: worker
gates.pass_condition: Native Qwen role succeeds within restart budget
gates.verification: roles.worker.status SUCCESS and restarts <= 2

gates.name: initial_fail
gates.pass_condition: Worker diagnosis leaves source unchanged and real immutable suite fails
gates.verification: WORKER_DIAGNOSIS_CONFIRMED source_unchanged and FAIL

gates.name: web_fetch
gates.pass_condition: HTTP200 source/content saved with URL and SHA
gates.verification: WEB-FETCHED PASS and raw source hash current

gates.name: web_context
gates.pass_condition: Inline exact research range bound to actual dispatched input and executed session
gates.verification: research-handoff.validate rechecks input/source/session; no model echo

gates.name: worker_correction
gates.pass_condition: Qwen produces relevant allowed source changes
gates.verification: native Worker SUCCESS and changed allowed source; no manual fix

gates.name: tests
gates.pass_condition: All 13 preexisting immutable acceptance tests pass
gates.verification: all approved test IDs exit0/PASS/marker and immutable SHA

gates.name: build
gates.pass_condition: All approved build checks pass
gates.verification: all approved builds exit0/PASS/marker

gates.name: checkpoint
gates.pass_condition: Immutable checkpoint exists before parent crash
gates.verification: controlled injection references checkpoint and manifest exists

gates.name: crash
gates.pass_condition: Exactly one owned parent crash after checks PASS
gates.verification: injection exists; checks passed before kill; PID birth owned

gates.name: watchdog
gates.pass_condition: Detect lost parent and finish cleanup
gates.verification: reason PARENT_PROCESS_LOST, no old parent alive before recovery

gates.name: start_recover
gates.pass_condition: Actual second Start -Recover before consultation
gates.verification: disk_recovery true and new native RUN_STARTED after watchdog

gates.name: continuation
gates.pass_condition: Recovered STATE/checkpoint and new Worker/tests continue, original clock unchanged
gates.verification: recovery event then new worker/checks PASS; original clock SHA unchanged

gates.name: chatgpt_send
gates.pass_condition: Fresh consultation, one physical send, same bound conversation and UTF8
gates.verification: send_attempts1, source/DOM SHA match, UTF8, user+1; retry adds0

gates.name: sent_confirmed
gates.pass_condition: SENT_CONFIRMED persisted before waiting for response
gates.evidence: new ledger history and monotonic trace
gates.verification: history SENT_CONFIRMED then COMPLETED; SENT precedes RESPONSE_WAIT_START

gates.name: response
gates.pass_condition: Response captured, assistant+1, composer empty; logical retry no resend
gates.verification: COMPLETED, response+composer+turn deltas and ALREADY_SENT/additional0

gates.name: reviewer
gates.pass_condition: Independent read-only Reviewer ACCEPTED
gates.verification: independent_reviewer_accepted and reviewer_readonly

gates.name: completion
gates.pass_condition: All objective/criteria/tests/build/artifacts/diff/pending/STATE gates true
gates.verification: COMPLETED and every required check true

gates.name: report
gates.pass_condition: Native terminal report COMPLETED and no hidden failure
gates.verification: report COMPLETED, technical SUCCESS, no reason

gates.name: cleanup
gates.pass_condition: No owned survivors, Run/Inference mutex free, no 8080/9119 listeners
gates.verification: final_cleanup and native_cleanup and no survivors/lock/listeners

gates.name: resources
gates.pass_condition: Continuous RAM/RSS/pagefile/process/GPU samples, no sustained critical condition or OOM
gates.verification: >=3 samples and GPU samples, no resource failure, normal duration <=2700

gates.name: integrity
gates.pass_condition: Frozen policies/model configuration/tests/history/clock preserved
gates.verification: every approved hash matches; immutable tests/clock/history unchanged
